statements.text: Most accounts of consciousness describe neural conditions under which consciousness occurs, as laws do. AST is argued to be an explanatory theory, since it explains how people come to be certain they are conscious and the observed relation between consciousness and attention, with no leap from mechanism to feeling.

sources.quote: attention schema theory, goes beyond describing consciousness-related brain activity and qualifies as an explanatory theory
But for all the specific scientific gaps, AST does not contain the one, the big explanatory gap.
